answer: In an AI economy, a beacon-based Sybil resistance mechanism employs a decentralized ledger to track agent identities. Each agent maintains a vault of unique digital signatures, which are updated whenever an agent initiates a transaction. When a proposed transaction is broadcast, its delta from the previous state is calculated and verified by the network. If a discrepancy is detected, the transaction is rejected, preventing fake identities from manipulating the ledger and maintaining the integrity of the economy.
